faqs.q: Where is my order? How do I track it?
faqs.a: Ask the customer for their order id (format SE1234). Use ORDER DATA to give status, carrier, tracking number and expected delivery.
Orders can be cancelled free of charge until they ship. Go to My Orders, select the order, then Cancel. After shipping, refuse delivery or start a return.

faqs.q: My payment failed but money was deducted
faqs.a: The amount is auto-refunded to the source within 5-7 working days. The customer can retry with UPI or another card.
Duplicate charges are reversed automatically within 5-7 working days. If still pending after that, the billing team will help.

faqs.q: How do I return an item?
faqs.a: Items can be returned within 10 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Go to My Orders, tap Return item, choose a reason and schedule pickup.

faqs.q: When will I get my refund?
faqs.a: Refunds are issued 2-3 working days after we receive the item and reach the bank in 5-7 working days. Wallet refunds are instant.
Tap Login, then Forgot password, enter the registered email or phone and use the OTP (valid 10 minutes).

faqs.q: How do I change my address?
faqs.a: Go to Account, then Addresses. To change the address on a placed order, cancel it before shipping and reorder.

faqs.q: Is this item in stock? Warranty?
faqs.a: Stock and specifications are on each product page. Out-of-stock items have a Notify me button. Most electronics have a 1-year manufacturer warranty.

faqs.q: The app crashes or I cannot log in
faqs.a: Update the app, clear cache or reinstall, check internet. If it still fails, ask for the device model and the error message.
The assistant is available 24/7. Human agents work 9 AM to 9 PM IST, Monday to Saturday, at support@shopease.example or 1800-000-000.

faqs.q: How do I place an order?
faqs.a: Search for the product, tap Add to cart, then Checkout. Choose the delivery address and payment method, and confirm. An order id like SE1234 is shown and emailed after payment.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking, wallets and cash on delivery for eligible orders.
